description: Complete optional carrier for the pay-to-play Qualified Financing gross-proceeds threshold and converted-debt proceeds election

primary.pattern: (\s+\[that would result in at least \$_______ in gross proceeds to the Corporation, \[including/excluding\] proceeds previously received by Corporation for debt that is being cancelled or converted in connection with such issuance\])

fixtures.anchor: [that would result in at least $_______ in gross proceeds to the Corporation, [including/excluding] proceeds previously received by Corporation for debt that is being cancelled or converted in connection with such issuance]
fixtures.note: The leading space is part of the optional carrier so omission cannot leave a doubled-space seam.
